selection.rule: Published IDs, weights, entropy domains and introduction epochs are immutable. New assets append at a new epoch.

targetSelector.exactHex: encode an exact hex as equal min/max RGB channel ranges
targetSelector.range: encode tolerant source colors as independent inclusive RGB ranges
targetSelector.priority: higher target priority wins; equal-priority overlaps are invalid

effects.rule: Targeted effects consume semantic masks produced by the same hex/range target map.

sounds.rule: Every sprite asset pins an exact Keel sound-profile object revision. Event variations resolve deterministically through the shared sound library and createAudioReader runtime.

metadata.labels: joined from the pinned Keel catalog after decode
metadata.tokenStorage: catalog revision plus compact numeric selections; no repeated names, descriptions or hex strings
